title: The bevelled cube's bevel-seam residue is the side of decision 275's far window when the far point lies on a window boundary, not a tie or tap-pool rule; Painter's side is an unreproduced float32 rounding, so a side-dependent ring texel is refused; under decisions 282 + 285 + 288, 54 of the Wand's 70 other texels are exact
